description: github.com/trending — repos ranked by starsGained (daily|weekly|monthly), not all-time stars (2 credits). Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 25, max 100). Flat 2 credits per call.

since.description: Trending window: daily (default), weekly, or monthly — matches github.com/trending?since=.
